summary: SkillSync backend + frontend E2E validated. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass covering demo-login (both roles), services/addresses, worker matching, full booking lifecycle (REQUEST_SENT -> COMPLETED), OTP visibility (customer-only), invalid transition -> 409, wrong-OTP rejection, additional charge approval, payment (UPI), review updates rating, audit events, notifications, SOS, worker stats. Real AI (Emergent LLM key, gpt-5.4-mini) verified via /problem-reports/{id}/analyze. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): auth screen -> demo customer login -> home with category grid + hero CTA -> Report screen with correct testIDs -> AI analysis screen shows detected problem 'Leaking Sink Pipe Joint' with 94% confidence, Medium severity, cost range 300-1200, safety warning -> find-pros-btn -> workers list (Rohit + Sanjay, verified badges, distance, ETA) -> book flow with saved address + date chip + time chip -> confirm-booking-btn -> booking detail with 'Request Sent' status, timeline, SOS button. Worker side: role-worker-btn + demo-login -> dashboard with availability toggle + stats + new job request card with AI estimate -> accept-job -> worker job screen -> start-navigation-btn -> WORKER_ON_WAY -> mark-arrived-btn -> WORKER_ARRIVED, OTP entry panel appears with 6 placeholder dots (NOT actual OTP digits) confirming OTP correctly hidden from worker payload. Wrong OTP produces toast 'Incorrect OTP. Ask the customer for the code shown in their app.' Post-OTP flow (inspection/quote/work/payment/review) covered by backend pytest but not UI-executed to conserve budget. No deprecated expo packages detected in package.json. RN Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' and 'pointerEvents') are Expo/RN internals not user code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1404 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, bookings, workers, worker_ops, notifications) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

Console shows RN Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. These come from third-party RN internals; main agent can suppress or migrate later.
seed_data_creation: Test run created two new bookings for customer@test.com (in addition to seeded ones). One booking left in WORKER_ARRIVED with OTP-panel state, another completed via pytest E2E. If clean state is desired, main agent can restart backend to reseed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_skillsync_e2e.py — runnable with `pytest -n 0` or via pytest.ini's default `-n 2 --dist loadscope` (module-scoped lifecycle_state pins one worker per module). Frontend flows: use role-customer-btn/role-worker-btn + demo-login-btn on /auth. Post-OTP flow selectors verified in report screen tids but not exercised end-to-end via UI — future test can wire correct 6-digit OTP by fetching GET /api/bookings/{id} with customer bearer token and typing into 'otp-input'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial pytest failures were test-side field-name mismatches (worker_id vs id key, InspectionBody expects 'problem'/'repair'/'labour' not 'problem_description'/'repair_plan'/'labour_charge', ProgressBody requires 'stage', additional-charge id must be fetched from GET /bookings after creation). All fixed.
